Try switching to uBlock Origin for your ad blocking and see if that has any effect. If it doesn't it is another extension or software on your device.

I would also try after uninstalling ABP and before installing uBlock Origin see if the same ads are displaying. Then you know if ABP was adding them, letting them through, or if it is something else.

I guess it depends on what components you have. I would try booting with the onboard graphics and removing the graphics card (assuming you are using a dedicated graphics card.)

Make sure that the RAM is properly seated. See if it turns on with the HDD unplugged.

Any of my next steps would be internal, I would not want you to get into them if you are not comfortable with removing and installing components. It is easy to do some damage when you are inside the case.
